checked_claims.claim: Clockwise individual turns, no rounds, immediate sixth-star game end and greatest fortune victory.
Base component categories; each faction has one character, four mechs, eight workers, four structures, four recruits, six cubes and six stars; combat-capable units.

All setup: random decks/mats, players+1 Factory cards without viewing surplus, eleven encounters, one structure tile, seating order, starting pieces/tracks/cards, two objectives and lowest-mat first player.
Secret card contents/public combat-card count, coin information rule and optional concealment of combat-card commitment.
Different action section; optional top then bottom once; full current red costs before optional green benefits; top gains may fund bottom; dead turn; Rusviet repeat and overlap limits.

Home bases are not territories; ordinary base entry/deploy/build restrictions; Wayfare/retreat exceptions; control by units or unopposed structures; defender pending-combat control; resource types, spending and supply.

Move two distinct units or one coin; resource/worker carrying; worker movement separate; river/lake/tunnel rules; Mine ownership/control; worker entry restrictions; enemy-worker displacement; hostile/encounter stopping; Speed.
Bolster cost, base benefits, deck exhaustion and Monument bonus.
Trade cost, base resources/popularity alternatives, controlled-worker placement, all-workers-home restriction and Armory bonus.

Produce payment before output; two distinct controlled territories; one output per worker; all terrain mappings; left-to-right worker production, later costs, optional output/permanence and Mill bonus production.
Mat-specific bottom costs/coins, continuing completed actions, announcement, oil Upgrade box legality, metal Deploy destination/ability scope, wood Build and food Enlist.
One structure per territory across all players; controlled worker requirement; Factory allowed/lake and base forbidden; permanence; all four structures and benefits even without control except Mill.

Recruit selection and fixed one-time location, exact two-token one-time benefits, ongoing source/action relation, exact one-token ongoing benefits, self/adjacent triggers, active-left-right priority and two-player single award.

All five starting faction abilities including Rusviet repeat/Factory, Crimea one-card-to-one-resource, Nordic workers-only river crossing, Polania two distinct options and Saxony unrestricted available objective/combat stars.
Every faction Riverwalk destination pair: Rusviet farm/village, Crimea farm/tundra, Nordic forest/mountain, Polania village/mountain and Saxony forest/mountain.
Saxony Underpass controlled mountains/all tunnels including own Mine; Disarm two-power loss on tunnel/Mine once per combat.
Rusviet Township controlled villages/Factory adjacency; Peoples Army exactly one extra card with at least one worker and character/mech participation.
Nordic Seaworthy lake movement and adjacent-lake retreat; transported-worker/resource limits; Artillery optional one power to remove two opposing power once per combat.
Crimea Wayfare own/inactive home-base destinations from territory/base irrespective of distance; Scout one random card before combat once per combat.

Polania Submerge lake movement/interlake adjacency; Camaraderie applies after aggressive combat victory, not undefended-worker displacement; shared lake restrictions and lack of adjacent-lake retreat.
Every star threshold and exception, permanence and mandatory placement, immediate end, bottom-action benefit/coins/own recruit completion, neighbor priority and pending-attack reversal.
Held coins and popularity-tier scoring; all nine rate entries, resource pairs pooled and odd leftover ignored, lakes count/home bases excluded, Factory three total and worked example 53 coins.

All six structure feature definitions and every payout band: adjacent tunnels/lakes/encounters, on tunnels, longest straight row, combined farm/tundra; unique counting, Mine exclusions, removed encounter tokens and rivers/control exceptions.
Six ordered tiebreakers, with character excluded from workers+mechs+structures count.
Combat only after all movement; multiple-combat choice; zero power/popularity permitted; attacker precombat ability before defender.
Both combatants simultaneously and secretly choose dial power 0 through min(7,current track power); this is the sole changed clause and is directly supported by SELECT POWER.

Cards per participating plastic unit and Rusviet extra card, zero dial legal, simultaneous reveal, attacker wins ties, both sides pay dial and discard played cards face-up, card values not deducted from track.

Winner control/star; continued combat after ordinary star limit; all losing units retreat leaving resources; Nordic eligible lake retreat; attacking worker popularity loss/defender exemption; positive-total loser card; no further combat after sixth star.

Character encounter timing and stop, token preserved after loss, card visibility/thematic text, affordable mandatory option payment/optional gains, encounter-hex placement, isolated benefit/cost and face-down bottom discard.

Each first character Factory finish chooses one permanent card after combat; fifth section, top/bottom optional sequence and Rusviet repeat; no normal mat bonuses; one-unit two-step or Speed three-step Move with Mine and normal stops.

Own-turn objective timing/full requirements, optional delay, both objectives bottom-discarded except Saxony retained second; unenforceable deals, only coins exchanged, tournament caveat and mandatory initiated combat.

limits: The complete rulebook does not reproduce every objective/encounter/Factory card or every physical Player Mat. Individual card texts and the full mat-specific price inventory were not separately audited; the candidate directs players to the printed mat/card values and accurately states governing rules.
This is an independent source-based exact-current-text update by the same source auditor, not a newly recruited fresh auditor. No benchmark results or other reports informed the verdict.
